text: {"lessons":["I should not sell a stock just because it has a gain; my average cost does not determine what is best to hold from here.","Realizing gains feels good, but that feeling can lead me to cut winners while avoiding painful decisions about losing positions. I should judge each holding by its future risk and potential, not by whether selling locks in a gain or loss.","Past price movements do not predict future returns, so I should avoid reacting to short-term account changes and keep decisions consistent with my long-term plan and diversification."]}
